verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key (FIDO2, OpenPGP card, PIV, OTP) with a device-management CLI. It is not an AI agent or tool-consuming host, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it consuming MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
